# dark_drawer_teaspoon — Round 2 realism review

Evidence: f3838, f3845, f3858; source index / 30 gives capture seconds. Three calibrated photo/render/overlay comparisons: [review.jpg](review.jpg). This is offline reconstruction, not online estimation.

Grades: {'silhouette': 'B', 'proportions': 'B', 'colour_texture': 'B', 'articulation': 'A', 'physics': 'B', 'collision': 'A', 'instances': 'C'}. Mean visible-region IoU: 0.8258; median colour ΔE76: 12.45; histogram TV: 0.524. The unchanged grading thresholds and correlated-mask limitations are documented in [../qa_summary.md](../qa_summary.md).

## Round 2 repairs

- Added a separate smaller right-channel design instead of instancing the oversized large spoon.
- Created a distinct photo mask in three views, excluding the foreground steel measuring spoon; fitted the bowl and both recorded layers.
- Final assembled review exposed a diagonal hidden handle; joint tail-landmark and bowl fitting reduced tail reprojection RMS from 131px to 13px while preserving collision clearance.
- Rebuilt the under-width bowl from the three source contours, widening it 15% and extending the bowl profile 8% while retaining the measured handle length and corrected pose.

## Physics and contacts

Canonical envelope [0.047642, 0.194123, 0.016605] m; dry mass estimate 0.04812 kg; material density 7900 kg/m³; friction 0.35; restitution 0.12. See model.json for material components, inertia, COM, uncertainty and deformable fallback parameters. Product mass is not measured. There are 74 closed convex pieces; contact margin 0.0001 m. Container membership is not a weld or rigid articulation.

## Remaining limits

- Exact product identity, weighed mass and measured friction remain unavailable; density-derived masses and contact coefficients are explicit priors.
- Illumination is approximate. Photo histograms and source-colour reflection maps are not calibrated albedo or HDR radiance measurements.
- Only the marked visible region is scored. Hidden dimensions and surface details remain bounded construction assumptions.
- Overlapping layers do not establish exact total count or every tip-to-handle/design association. Repaired layer observations remain provisional; instances is C, not certified away.

## Rebuild

Run Blender with `-b -P build.py`; the shared generator reads `../assets.json`, `../build_common.py` and `../qa_geometry.py`. OBJ coordinates are canonical metres, +Z up. GLB is glTF +Y up; Blender dynamic origins are at COM. Repeat the calibrated render, collision and metadata checks after rebuilding; old QA grades must not be assumed valid after edits.

physics_properties.articulation: No rigid joint observed; utensils are independently removable. Parent references are containment, except the organizer drawer transform.

density_mass_estimate.method: Sum of signed visual solid volumes after welding GLB UV/normal seams, multiplied by material density. Manufacturing submesh overlaps are not boolean-unioned; estimate is not a weighed product. Collision shell chord volumes are not used as material mass.

physics_properties.mass_justification: 0.04812 kg from visual solid material volumes multiplied by nominal densities; manufacturing overlaps and unobserved construction remain uncertain. See density_mass_estimate.
